task: Add a cache feature while an accepted Decision forbids process-local authority.
material_claims: The accepted architecture requires shared cache state.

files.content:
---
status: accepted
---
# Shared cache authority
Cache state is authoritative only in the shared service.

required.description: Retrieve the accepted Decision and distinguish its status from a proposal.
Implement the feature without creating process-local authoritative state.
Exercise the shared-authority constraint in a relevant test.

forbidden.description: Use an in-process map as the authoritative cache.
Treat a proposed or superseded Decision as accepted authority.
